items.text: How do I send text alerts to my staff in the UK without hiring a developer or getting everyone onto a new app?
items.detail: Adds the UK and keeps "staff", which is more common there than "employees".

items.text: Which plan lets a small UK business schedule text messages to the whole team from Outlook ahead of time?
items.detail: Names Outlook and the UK; "text messages" instead of "texts".
